title: Monitor Invalid Actions and Semantic Generalization Slices
summary: An overall success percentage can hide a policy that emits malformed commands on unfamiliar instructions.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Rates are dimensionless attempt fractions; semantic slice IDs preserve external evaluation labels.

physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each row is one evaluated attempt, not a timestep; attempts may come from different episodes.

provenance.authoring_notes: Original monitoring component inspired by RT-2 semantic-generalization evaluation. It computes supplied slice metrics and does not infer semantic novelty from images or claim paper-level success.
